treatment_protocol.agent_instruction: Treat identifiers as case-sensitive: copy exact spellings from inspected source and verify them before the final answer. The fixture is history-free with its baseline staged, so use git diff for edits but do not expect Git history or remotes. For behavior changes, first run the smallest reproduction using the standard library or tools already present; do not install dependencies or attempt network access. For workspace-diff tasks, edit the workspace, run a focused check, inspect the diff, and stop; do not spend the bounded session on broad exploration.
treatment_protocol.codira_mcp_instruction: Before shell search, call index_status and require usable=true, a positive indexed_file_count, ready non-partial generation, and zero failed files. Then use context_for_task or the narrowest Codira tool before broader search. Omit cursor unless continuing with an exact returned next_cursor; never send an empty cursor. If the index is unusable, stop Codira calls and report the infrastructure defect instead of treating no matches as repository evidence.
